newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed sheds gains, groundnut steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed sheds gains, groundnut steady.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery shed gains on Tuesday, dropping around eight rupees to 1,151/1,152 rupees per quintal on renewed speculative selling, floor sources said.
Absence of fresh overseas buying as well as increased arrivals prompted profit-taking.
Castorseed arrivals in Gujarat rose to 24,000/25,000 bags (75 kg each) against 16,000/17,000 bags reported on Monday.
"Reports of progress of monsoon in the producing centres also subdued the market sentiments," one trader said.
Groundnut oil rose from 352/353 rupees to 356/357 rupees per 10 kg on reduced arrivals due to heavy rain in producing centres.
Imported palm oil slid by two to three rupees to 266/267 rupees per 10 kg as local importers made fresh offerings after seeing world prices slip.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 555/560 rupees per 15 kg.
